Save this before you book a room for an early Tokyo arrival. Four quick checks decide whether your first morning is hands-free or spent dragging a suitcase around the city 👇

🔗 Every time and price we checked is on this page 👉 https://japanbystation.com/tokyo-early-arrival-luggage

1️⃣ Front desk hours. Look for "24 hours" in the hotel FAQ. Sotetsu Fresa Inn Tokyo-Toyocho, for example, says exactly that.

2️⃣ Bags before check-in. Find the line that says the hotel keeps luggage before check-in. Note the limits: the same FAQ excludes luggage that is too large or in large quantities.

3️⃣ Apartment check-in window. The Kinshicho flat we checked runs check-in from 16:00 to 22:00 with an unmanned desk. Ask the host for a named drop-off place and its hours.

4️⃣ The locker plan B. JR East's usual prices: S ¥500, M ¥700–800, L ¥900–1,000. Its reservable Multi ecube lockers can be booked up to a month ahead, at ¥100–200 more for M and L in busy periods.

💡 Tip: use a locker at the station where your day ends, not where it starts, so you pick the bag up on the way to bed.
